purpose: Public-safe display labels and claim boundaries for data-v4 runs. Use these labels in visualizers instead of raw folder names or internal run ids.

tiers-gate-on-300s.traffic_shape: noisy standard surge with steady premium
tiers-gate-on-300s.claim_boundary: Shows priority separation under saturated load; not a full SLO proof without a named latency objective and matched detector comparison.

tiers-gate-off.traffic_shape: noisy standard surge with steady premium

batch-gate-on.traffic_shape: batch surge with foreground traffic present
batch-gate-on.claim_boundary: Shows deferrable work is queued behind interactive tiers instead of being rejected.

batch-gate-off.traffic_shape: batch surge with foreground traffic present
batch-gate-off.claim_boundary: Shows rejection behavior without the gate.

batch-eviction.traffic_shape: batch starts first, then realtime begins with a burst and continues as a seeded open-loop Poisson process with a sinusoidally varying rate
batch-eviction.claim_boundary: Shows reserved-capacity latency and safe batch recovery in the tested single-replica path; it does not prove multi-replica coordination or an absolute SLO.

consolidation-gate-on.traffic_shape: two premium tenants steady while standard floods the shared pool
consolidation-gate-on.claim_boundary: Shows premium tenants stay ahead of standard traffic on a single shared GPU.

consolidation-gate-off.traffic_shape: two premium tenants steady while standard floods the shared pool
consolidation-gate-off.claim_boundary: Shows the same consolidated traffic shape without flow-control ordering.

fairness-bigburst-gate-on.display_name: Same-priority burst fairness, flow control on
fairness-bigburst-gate-on.traffic_shape: one same-priority tenant bursts while peers share the band
fairness-bigburst-gate-on.claim_boundary: Shows bounded same-band dispatch behavior; it does not prove a separate latency tier among equal-priority tenants.

fairness-gate-on.traffic_shape: same-priority premium tenants with one higher-volume tenant
fairness-gate-on.claim_boundary: Older fairness evidence; use the big-burst run for the current headline.

fairness-gate-off.traffic_shape: same-priority premium tenants with one higher-volume tenant

multi-replica-tiers.claim_boundary: Shows multi-replica behavior for the prior detector; upstream concurrency-detector scale-out still needs a matched run.

upstream-sweep.traffic_shape: single tuning scenario across maxConcurrency values
upstream-sweep.claim_boundary: Finds the upstream maxConcurrency knee; not a four-scenario detector comparison.

operating-point-sweep.claim_boundary: Finds the operating region where queueing policy has work to do.
